name: ship-usp-talon-light-fighter
summary: The starting USP Talon: a brown teardrop/delta fighter with a pointed nose, a cockpit slit, a bright centre spine and two engine bulges set into the rear hull; angular hard surface.

traits: dark slit across the nose (rows 9-11, columns 10-13)
features.note: The cockpit slit; must read as glass, not paint.
The narrow pointed nose ahead of the cockpit.

traits: bright highlight column down the centre (column 12)
features.note: The bright centre spine from the cockpit to the tail; a raised crease, metal sheen spots on it.

traits: rounded bulge set into the hull
dark gap separating it from the fuselage (column 9)
features.note: The left engine pod bulge (rows 17-23, columns 4-8).

traits: rounded bulge set into the hull
separated from the fuselage by a dark line
features.note: The right engine pod bulge (rows 17-23, columns 15-19).
The central fuselage between the engine bulges.
The ribbed bands across the tail.

traits: the hull widening from the cockpit to the pods
features.note: The flanks where the delta widens behind the cockpit.

concept.source: Gemini (Nano Banana) high-res reimagining of the level-frame sprite, 2026-10-28, with the user's prompt (same overhead outline, don't take pixels literally)
concept.use: Design guide for what each part is and its shape language; the sprite decides the top-view outline, proportions and colours.
